operations_plan.summary: Apply a continuous 2 mm constant-radius fillet to the externally exposed upper perimeter edges of the central scroll-wheel slot in the housing, while preserving the scroll wheel and all unrelated housing geometry.

steps.description: Isolate housing solid 0 for editing and identify the complete externally exposed slot-rim edge chain. Select the four upper boundary edges shared by the broad top-deck face 6 and the wheel-well side/end wall faces 0, 1, 2, and 3. Treat these shared edges as the perimeter of the scrolling-wheel slot. Exclude the lower edges where wall faces 0–3 meet recessed floor face 4, and exclude every edge belonging to scroll-wheel solid 1. This resolves the requested edges as the visible top rim rather than every edge through the recess depth.

Verify that the selected edges form one closed rectangular perimeter around the wheel and that a 2 mm rolling-ball fillet can be accommodated by the adjacent top-deck and well-wall surfaces without reaching recessed floor face 4, opening the housing unintentionally, or intersecting scroll-wheel solid 1. Use the existing wheel position and its clearance to the well walls as fixed reference geometry; do not move, resize, or otherwise modify the wheel. If automatic tangent-chain selection extends onto unrelated outer-shell edges, disable tangent propagation and retain only the four explicitly identified slot-rim edges.

On housing solid 0, execute one constant-radius edge-fillet operation on the closed upper slot-perimeter edge set identified in step 1. Set the fillet radius to exactly 2 mm and solve all four edges together so the side and end blends meet continuously at the slot corners. The operation shall replace the sharp intersections between top-deck face 6 and well-wall faces 0–3 with smooth transition faces while leaving recessed floor face 4 unchanged. Do not include scroll-wheel solid 1 in the fillet operation and do not create, remove, or reposition any section or solid.

Regenerate and validate the result. Confirm that the slot has a continuous 2 mm radius around its complete externally visible upper rim, with no residual sharp corner segments, self-intersections, failed blends, or breaks in housing solid 0. Check that the outer mouse envelope and unrelated faces remain unchanged, recessed floor face 4 remains intact, and scroll-wheel solid 1 retains its original geometry, position, X-oriented rotation axis, and operating clearance within the rounded slot.
